description: Filter every stock on one date by its daily metrics. filters maps column.op to a number, for example {"ret_21d.gt": 0.1, "pct_off_52w_high.gte": -0.05, "avg_turnover_20d.gte": 50000000}. Columns: adj_close, ret_1d, ret_5d, ret_21d, ret_63d, ret_126d, ret_252d, ret_ytd, high_52w, low_52w, pct_off_52w_high, pct_off_52w_low, avg_vol_20d, avg_vol_60d, avg_turnover_20d. Ops: gt, gte, lt, lte. Returns are fractions (0.1 means 10%). universe restricts to the point-in-time liquid100, liquid250 or liquid500 members. date defaults to the latest; meta.date is the day used. Returns 50 rows by default, up to 200. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

date.description: Trading date. Default: latest. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

filters.description: column.op to value, up to 10 filters.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

order.description: asc or desc. Numeric columns default to desc.

universe.description: Only members of this universe on that date.

name: screener
title: Stock screener
